Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM/service management systems to manage customer support activities. Familiarity with networking fundamentals, Windows operating systems, software deployment, and remote support tools is beneficial. Familiarity with, or proficiency in, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, and other life sciences related regulations is highly beneficial. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Ability to work well within a global, cross functional team. Ability to prioritize and work independently to achieve defined goals. Must be fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills. Willingness to travel occasionally for customer site visits and training. Focused on cost and process efficiencies, we deliver innovative technologies and solutions that help set new standards in bioprocessing.
